figures.caption: (A) Reverse-phase HPLC chromatogram of lyophilised Androctonus aeneas venom. The arrow indicates the elution position/retention time of the peptide fraction (#145) exhibiting antimicrobial activity. AU = 214 nm, and the gradient was formed from TFA/water (0.05:99.95, v/v) to TFA/water/acetonitrile (0.1:19.95:80.00, v/v/v) in 240 min at a flow rate of 1 mL/min. (B) MALDI-TOF mass spectrum of a sample of Fraction #145 indicating singly-charged [M + H]+ ions at m/z 1989.50 and m/z 2017.68. The ion at m/z 2039.07 is likely to be a sodium adduct ion [M + Na]+ of the peptide at m/z 2017.68.

figures.caption: Dose-dependent antiproliferative effects of the analogues, AaeAP1a and AaeAP2a, on the human cancer cell lines, H460, MB435s, MCF-7 and PC3, after 24 h of incubation. The levels of significance are: * p < 0.05; ** p < 0.01; *** p < 0.001. Note that at low concentrations (10−9 M and 10−8 M), AaeAP1a significantly increased the proliferation of H460 cancer cells (p < 0.01). AaeAP2a significantly increased (p < 0.05) the proliferation of MB435s cancer cells at 10−9 M and the proliferation of MCF-7 cancer cells at 10−8 M (p < 0.05) and at 10−9 M (p < 0.01). The growth inhibition of cells at each peptide concentration was calculated as a percentage of the growth observed in controls, which was treated as 100%.
